blocks.label: Sector Patrol
blocks.instructions:
Sector PatrolFour patrol sectors are available. Each shift, choose a sector to monitor.
  • Each sector yields intelligence contacts (points), but some sectors carry occasional incident costs — equipment issues, false escalations, or interference from rough conditions.
  • You start with 2000 pts. Learn which sectors are worth patrolling over time.
  • There are no right or wrong answers — just try to finish with as many points as possible.
